content: The root cause was the Redis feature‑store’s configuration – it was limited to a 24 GB `maxmemory` and set to `noeviction`. As the fraud‑scorer pods kept writing per‑card counters, the cache grew unchecked until it hit that ceiling, after which Redis refused all writes (`OOM command not allowed`). In short, the “no‑eviction” setting on the feature cache caused it to fill up and exhaust memory.
name: gather
